extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store

extDescription.message: Turn YouTube into a productivity tool: a minimal interface instead of algorithms
extDescription.description: Short description. Chrome limit is 132 characters

popupTimerTitle.description: Heading of the timer section in the popup

timerReset.description: Button that stops the countdown and returns it to the full length

timerClose.description: Button that dismisses the timer window on the YouTube page
